limitations: Unseen surfaces and orthographic illustrations are inferred artwork, not measured CAD or recovered original hidden pixels.
Exact map reconstruction can include residual patches; those patches are reconstruction data, not seamless semantic procedural assets.
Replay may derive PNGs from retained raw atlases or restore immutable PNG snapshots. Snapshot restoration is not raw-image regeneration or a repeat image-model invocation.
Recorded unavailable directions remain unapproved reference images; their sets remain incomplete and cannot qualify as whole-set reusable providers.
Attachment tags are editorial semantic suggestions; they do not establish collision, support geometry, scale compatibility, or runtime placement safety.
A shared batch input rejection has unknown individual request attribution; conservative unavailable targets are not individually attributed rejected outputs.
